text: Machine learning is a part of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model that can make predictions about new information. For example, a model can learn to recognise emails that are spam. After training, we test the model to see how often its predictions are correct. This is called accuracy. A good model makes accurate predictions, while a weak model makes many mistakes. Machine learning is used in many areas today, such as medicine, shopping, and transport.
